# AGENTS.md

Instructions for coding agents, and for people, working on **{{product}}**. {{One sentence on
what the product is.}} The product brief is [docs/product-brief.md](docs/product-brief.md).

This repo follows Knowledge-Driven Programming: the decisions the software is made of are written
down next to the code, and every change is checked against them before it is made.

## Contexts

The product is a modular monolith: one deployable app, one module per bounded context, each module
with its own Postgres schema and its own domain skill.

| Context | Module | Skill | Classification |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| {{context}} | [modules/{{context}}](modules/{{context}}/) | [.claude/skills/{{context}}](.claude/skills/{{context}}/SKILL.md) | {{core / supporting / generic}} |

How they relate, the junctions between them and the open questions:
[docs/context-map.md](docs/context-map.md).

**Work in a context goes through its skill.** It activates on its own when the work touches the
context. It holds the glossary, the invariants, the promises and the decisions.

## Commands

```sh
pnpm install
docker compose up -d          # Postgres for development and tests
pnpm dev                      # the API, from source
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test:unit                # unit and architecture tests, every module
pnpm test:scenarios           # the promises, every module
pnpm test:integration         # adapters on Postgres (needs TEST_DATABASE_URL)
pnpm build
node scripts/gyos-doctor.ts   # are the skills and the knowledge still in shape?
```

A new context: `/gyos:context`. A new feature: `/gyos:feature`. A decision: `/gyos:decide`.

## Rules

- **Modules** follow [docs/standards/module.md](docs/standards/module.md). The architecture tests
  enforce it; a failing one is a design problem, not a test to adjust.
- **Domain skills** follow [docs/standards/domain-skill.md](docs/standards/domain-skill.md).
- **Ask, never invent.** Business rules come from the people who own the product. What isn't
  confirmed is marked `Unverified:` or goes to an open question.
- **Decisions are append-only.** A change of mind is a new entry that supersedes the old one
  ([docs/decisions/README.md](docs/decisions/README.md)).
- **Knowledge changes with the code,** in the same commit.
- {{Repo-wide rules the team adds: git flow, review, deploy.}}
